title: Complex Subordinating Clauses in Persian
summary: Connecting clauses using advanced complex conjunctions (به‌محضِ آن‌که, همین‌که).
explanation: Advanced Persian uses compound conjunctions for precise temporal or causal relationships.
rules: Complex Conjunction + Subordinate Clause + Main Clause

example_translations.ex_csub_1: As soon as he/she arrived, the meeting started.

common_error_explanations.err_csub_1: Ensure full conjunction forms like 'به‌محضِ آن‌که' are used correctly.
